verdict.rationale: Docs mention 'premium names' browsing and 'discovery' pricing returned by the availability-check endpoint, plus tiered TLD pricing types, suggesting some premium-domain support in search. However there is no evidence of a marketplace or broker workflow for already-registered (taken) domains — no backorder, make-offer, or aftermarket listing feature is documented. missing for 10: explicit premium pricing display in search UI/API responses, a marketplace/broker path for taken domains, backorder or offer-submission mechanism.
